About

AI is changing the bottleneck. Engineering still decides the outcome.

I’m a Software Development Engineer at ServiceNow, part of the Strategic Portfolio Management organization. I work at the intersection of enterprise applications, AI and modern full-stack engineering — building intelligent agents, AI skills, workflow orchestration and LLM-powered experiences that help large organizations plan and deliver work.

Before that I was an R&D Engineer at Dassault Systèmes, and before that I ran a freelance studio that shipped 20+ web and mobile products for clients. I’m most excited about AI-native software, where agents, automation and human–AI collaboration change how work gets done.

  1. 01

    AI for speed

    I use AI to collapse the distance between an idea and a working first version — prototypes in an afternoon, not a sprint.

  2. 02

    Engineering for direction

    Architecture, security, testing and performance are what turn a demo into a product. That part is still engineering.

  3. 03

    Judgment for impact

    The hard question is rarely “how do I write this?” It is “is this the right thing to build?” — and that stays human.

Notes on building with AI

I write about AI agents, RAG and what AI means for engineering — for 1.6K+ followers on LinkedIn.

AI Agents

Everyone is building AI agents. Most will fail.

Production AI is more than a prompt — memory, tool calling, validation, error recovery, permissions and monitoring are what separate demos from products.

6-page carousel Framework

How I build AI agents that actually work

Clear purpose, strong architecture, memory, tools, reliability, continuous evaluation and feedback loops. The best AI products aren’t magic — they’re engineered.

7-page guide RAG

Most RAG problems aren’t LLM problems

They’re retrieval problems. Retrieve more, rerank, and send only the best context to the model.

Architecture note Engineering

AI makes engineering judgment more important

AI reduces the cost of writing code. It doesn’t reduce the cost of making the right decision.
